# Konooz Al-Ahram Eye Hospital

> Official website and patient portal of Konooz Al-Ahram Eye & Ophthalmic Surgery Hospital in Benghazi, Libya. Bilingual (Arabic-first, RTL) Next.js 15 site with department information, surgical cost estimates, vision self-screening, appointment booking via WhatsApp, and a device-local patient portal.

Key facts:

- Arabic is the default language; English is available via the header switcher or `/en` prefix.
- Patient profile data is stored only in the visitor's browser — nothing is sent to a server.
- Booking requests open a pre-filled WhatsApp draft that the user sends themselves.
- Built with Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript strict mode, Tailwind CSS v4, Prisma + PostgreSQL.

## Pages

- [Homepage (Arabic)](https://konozealahram-eye.ly/ar): departments, doctors, services, booking, patient portal, operations dashboard.
- [Homepage (English)](https://konozealahram-eye.ly/en): English version of the homepage.
- [Privacy Policy (Arabic)](https://konozealahram-eye.ly/ar/privacy): data handling and patient privacy.
- [Privacy Policy (English)](https://konozealahram-eye.ly/en/privacy): English privacy policy.
